name: PSG Corporation Public Company Limited
summary: PSG Corporation Public Company Limited, along with its subsidiary, provides comprehensive engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services for major building and infrastructure endeavors across Thailand and the Lao People's Democratic Republic. The company's offerings encompass a wide array of construction specializations, including civil engineering, industrial facilities, structural superstructures, mechanical and electrical systems, installation projects, and vital road and general infrastructure developments. Established in 1981, this Bangkok-headquartered firm operated as T Engineering Corporation Public Company Limited until it rebranded as PSG Corporation Public Company Limited in October 2021.
